verifications.claim: Paul Thomas Anderson won the Best Director Oscar for the film One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Paul Thomas Anderson has won the best director Academy Award for his film “One Battle After Another.”' at 98th on 03-15-26; R2: 'Paul Thomas Anderson won for best director' for 'One Battle After Another' at 98th on March 15, 2026; R3/R4/R5/R6 similar direct statements.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the win, film, 98th Oscars, and exact date.

verifications.claim: Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director Oscar win marked his first Oscar win.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'had already been up on stage, accepting the Oscar for best adapted screenplay' before best director; R6: 'second ever Oscar, following his win earlier... for best adapted screenplay'; R4: 'best directing and best adapted screenplay, marking his first-ever wins' (plural, but sequence shows adapted first).
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm adapted screenplay win preceded best director that night, so director win was not his first.
